eps.t: Triple D Nation: Seafood, Schnitzel and Spam
eps.o: This trip, Guy Fieri's headed back to top spots servin' up some fresh takes! Just outside New Orleans, a sizzlin' seafood joint has expanded, still going boat-to-table with dynamite Delacroix drum nachos and the-bomb backyard boiled crawfish. An old-school diner with a tribute to the troops in Fountain Valley, Calif., is busier than ever, dishing out smoked spam loco moco and puttin' their stamp…

A Tampa butcher is bringing righteous roast pork from farm to sandwich, a pastaria in Bentonville, AR, is plating lights-out lasagna and a family-run spot is putting out a legit noodle bowl in Rogers, AR.

eps.t: Triple D Nation: Sandwiches, Scandinavian and Street Tacos
eps.o: A funky Filipino joint in Sacramento, Calif., is making cookies and a West Palm Beach, Fla., spot is smoking gator sausage.
Q family-run spot in Rogers, AR, is plating funkalicious shawarma and kebabs and a fishmonger-turned-restaurateur is making legit lobster ravioli in Bentonville, AR.

eps.t: Triple D Nation: A World of Flavortown
eps.o: An Irish pub-restaurant in Louisville, KY, is going strong with scrumptious salmon rillettes, a Chicago joint is serving up steamed pork buns and a rocking spot in Texas is churning out chicharron tacos.

There's righteous ramen in Rogers, Ark., servin' up finger-lickin' karaage chicken and gangster garlic miso. A Seattle spot is putting a Lebanese spin on over-the-top tacos and burritos with the-bomb beef and killer carnitas. Plus, a craveable comfort joint in Bentonville, Ark., is slingin' serious sammies, like a smoked French dip and a sizzlin' skirt steak with an Asian twist.
A spot in Austin, TX, is doing a salsa-chicken pie from scratch, a New Orleans joint is firing up country-fried chicken and a brother-sister team in Chicago is serving Seoul-style dumplings.
